description: This file provides UI helper functions for animations and visual transitions, such as crossfades and subtle appear effects, in an Android application.

methods.name: animDuration
methods.description: Resolves an integer resource duration (ms) as a Long.

methods.name: crossfadeVisibility
methods.description: Performs a crossfade animation to show or hide a View without layout thrash.

methods.name: subtleAppear
methods.description: Animates a View to subtly appear with fade-in and slight upward translation.
